notes.title: Astral Outcast Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
Quick Hotfix for the demo.

✨ Improvements:


- Popups are now grouped.

- Icebox on ship now only accepts ice.

- All Containers are now categorized: Resources, Food, Clothes, etc.

- Inventory items can now be transfered with SHIFT-LMB.

- You can now drag items from and to containers.



 🔧 Fixes:


- Fixed a quest progression issue with ship planters.

- Added a Cancel button for the amount slider.

notes.title: Astral Outcast Demo v2.5 (Build 87)
notes.content:
New update for the demo.

✨ Improvements:
- Added "Home" icon to LZ when you built a base there.
- Expanded Map Helios I LZ1.
- Expanded Map Helios II LZ2.
- Added recipe for radiation cure pills.
- Container Lids are now salvagable.
- Added asteroid II. (Atmosphere, LZ1)
- Added Helios IV Moon I. (Atmosphere, LZ1)
- Added music on maps.
- Added option to play in sandbox mode.
- Resources are now pure on asteroids and less so on planets.
- Added regolith instead of stone on Asteroids.
- Added alternate recipe to make dirt with regolith.
- Added a new mining feature.(Deep Core Mining.)
- Added Battery Charger inside Engine Room.
- Added a button to open up the Journal on screen.
- Added ability to remove the current heatshield.
- Added new recipes: Battery, Auto Drill, Iron Sheet, Diamond Drill, Damaged heatshield recycle.
- Added some sound effects : Ship Landing/Take Off. Drinking and Eating. Airlock sound.
- Only with a Crowbar equipped the spot to install your Heatshields shows up.
- Simplified Ship windows (Showing what planet you're on and what time of day.)
- Added Tired Icon and Overweight on top of Player when Exhausted.
- Changed max inventory places to 25.
- Ice now melts away when not refrigerated.
- Added a buildable Ice Box in the Storage Room.
- You can now place a full canister in the Engine Room to have a reserve close by.
- Added better sound effect for Ship Boost.
- Added Cave Ambience.
- Revamped Farming System.(New Plugin.)
- Finetuning new farming system.
- Added Copper, Titanium Deep Core Mine. 
- Added a console in the Command Deck to check current time on planets.


🔧 Fixes:
- Added missing footsteps to Helios I.
- Airlock finetuning.
- Performance work.
- Reworked Heatshielding system.
- Adjusted volume of sound effects.
- Fixed typo in intro scene.
- Footsteps bug fixed.
- Fixed a bug with Airlock.
- Fixed Performance issue with HUD.
- Bug fixes for HUD.

notes.title: Astral Outcast Demo v2.0 (Build 80)
notes.content:
A lot of work done for the Demo:

✨ Improvements:
- Continued work on Gather Nodes Revamp.
- New maps added (Helios I - LZ2)
- Exiting the ship shows tips now with new plugin.(Fake loading screen)
- Working on Act II of the Story.
- Added Footsteps plugin.
- Tweaked Footsteps.
- Added Ship Tracker on Asteroid I Dark Side maps.
- Added Ship Way points to all other maps.
- Added Cave exit light from outside.
- You can now use the processor while running on backup power.
  (The ship will fly much slower without fuel.)
- Worked on Base Building.
- Finished Building Quest.

🔧 Fixes:
- Gather Node Collisions bug fixed.
- Fixed HUD hider on screen edge.
- Fixed Inventory drag (Should be more fine tuned now)
- Fixed bug on Ship Fuel empty.
- Fixed bug with Footsteps.
- Fixed some player sprites.
- Fixed bug with Journal.
- Fixed Recipe Unlocked bug.
- Magnetic Boots cannot be removed from inventory anymore. (Preventing soft locks)
- Oxygen Alarm inside the ship now activates when less then 10% is in the tanks.
  (Giving the player extra time.)
- Fixed bug with text balloons.
- Fixed bug with a quest description.
- Fixed soft lock when ship power off you could not reach the airlock.
- Developing Intro quest further.
- Discovered bug when flying spaceship while boosting and pressing "Q".
